name: Elder Brain
oracle_text:
Menace
Whenever this creature attacks a player, exile all cards from that player's hand, then they draw that many cards. You may play lands and cast spells from among the exiled cards for as long as they remain exiled. If you cast a spell this way, you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it.
blocked_sentences: You may play lands and cast spells from among the exiled cards for as long as they remain exiled.
If you cast a spell this way, you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it.

needs.what: a play-permission duration with no end and no delayed start -- "for as long as they remain exiled" -- usable on `exile`'s / `grant_playable`'s `playable` key, starting the turn the cards are exiled
needs.why_existing_wont_do: PLAYABLE_DURATIONS is this_turn, your_next_end_step, end_of_your_next_turn and later_turns; the first three expire, and later_turns (Plot) forbids playing on the current turn, but Elder Brain's cards are playable immediately during the same combat/second main phase

needs.what: a cast permission flag meaning "you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it": coloured pips may be paid with mana of any colour, but colourless mana still pays only generic/{C}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_playable's `any_type` relaxes cost via ManaCost.as_any_type, which folds every coloured pip into generic so colourless mana can pay {B} -- that is "mana of any type" (Valigarmanda), strictly broader than "as though it were mana of any color"
